featureBullets: 2Pcs Phone Stand Set: The convenient, compact and durable phone stands allow you to hold your phone anywhere and anytime. It is ideal for both work and at home. Nulaxy is committed to making your smart life more enjoyable, so we provide 2 pack set to meet your diverse needs.

Adjustable & Portable: The phone holder cradle collapses completely. It is easily adaptable to the proper position.Make it an excellent desk companion for watching videos, playing games, making phone calls, viewing recipes, and using Facetime.

Sturdy & Protective: The desk phone stand is made of high-quality premium aluminum. It keeps firmly in place and steadily supports your phone, with no fear of wobbling. The rubber pads will shield your phone from scratches and slippage. Warm Tips: Please set your device (4"-6") to landscape or portrait mode and your device (6"-8") to landscape mode for more excellent stability.

Case Friendly: The phone stand's hook width is 18mm, so there's no need to remove your phone case, and it's long enough to hold your smartphone even with a HEAVY CASE on. Please ensure that your gadget is no thicker than 18mm " (0.71").

Compatibility: This phone stand holder is compatible with all 4-8 Smartphones, e-readers, including the iPhone 18 17 16 15 14 13 12 11 Pro Max Xs Xr X 8 7 6, Switch, Samsung Galaxy S10/S10+/S9/S9+/S8/S8+, Samsung Tab, Google Nexus, and Kindle.
